target: Record the Batch-1 rendering/lifecycle optimizations (thumbnail caching, ThreeCanvas cleanup + time-based motion, prioritized concurrency-limited GLB loading) informed by an external read-only audit.
summary: Batch 1 of a performance/optimization pass, built with two parallel subagents plus a direct stream, in response to an external read-only source audit (Astra). (1) Catalog thumbnails: thumbnailStudio.ts now caches the fitted model clone per modelKey (clone + Box3 fit + recenter + scale once, not every frame); LeftDrawer.tsx cards are static by default and animate only when hovered/selected AND on-screen (IntersectionObserver), driven by a single shared rAF scheduler instead of one permanent rAF per card. Steady-state idle cost drops from N clones + N bounds-fits + N renders per frame to zero. (2) ThreeCanvas lifecycle: cleanup now disposes OrbitControls, RenderPass/UnrealBloomPass/EffectComposer, removes the webglcontextlost listener, clears the rebuildable scene groups (socket arms, portals, core) via the shared borrowed-GLB-safe helper, and disposes the ghost mesh + trajectory line; the async preload continuation is guarded by a disposed flag so it never rebuilds a torn-down scene or setStates after unmount. Docked-orb and satellite spins are now elapsed-time (dt) based so speed is frame-rate independent. (3) gltfLoaderService.ts loads the critical scene set first through a bounded concurrency pool (6 at a time, not all ~33/82 MiB at once), tracks per-model idle/loading/loaded/error status with a subscribe API, and exposes preloadModels() and retryModel(); the existing preloadAllGltfModels contract is unchanged. No borrowed-GLB geometry/material disposal discipline was weakened; Stellar remains dormant.
observations: Files changed: src/utils/gltfLoaderService.ts (concurrency pool + critical-first order + status/retry, additive), src/utils/thumbnailStudio.ts + src/components/LeftDrawer.tsx (thumbnail caching + gated animation, subagent), src/components/ThreeCanvas.tsx (cleanup/disposal + unmount guard + time-based rotation, subagent).

Disposal safety preserved: only meshes flagged proceduralGeometry/ownedMaterial are disposed; cloned-GLB resources shared with gltfModelCache are never disposed; the shared clearRebuildableGroup helper was reused for unmount teardown.

Verification: npx tsc --noEmit passes; vite build passes; all 76 app tests pass. Live preview confirmed the CORE scene, catalog thumbnails, and CORE->Orb->Satellite->Actuator drill-down still work; per-tab console message volume dropped sharply (528 vs ~3353) with the per-card thumbnail churn removed.

Audit framing honored: gains are inferred from code, not measured FPS; recommend capturing draw-call/frame-time/time-to-interactive deltas (cabinet open vs closed) before claiming numeric improvement.
recommendations: Treat this record as passive continuity only; it authorizes no further change.

summary: Two changes landed and verified green under direct user direction, closing the C-0008 open work. (1) Capabilities Exchange (handshake step 5) fix: the redesigned software catalog (IDE-TOTEM-C-0004) declares 20 infrastructure requirement tokens (network_listener, secret_store, clock_source, db_connection, persistent_volume, durable_state, cpu_time, thread_pool, multi_core, ...) that were disjoint from the capability vocabulary the CORE advertised via getCoreRuntimeCapabilities (only memory_heap overlapped), so nearly every Orb failed step 5 with 'Unsatisfied capabilities' and no contract was created. The capability-derivation logic was extracted from App.tsx into a pure, testable engine module src/engine/coreCapabilities.ts (getAvailableCoreResources + getCoreRuntimeCapabilities + CORE_SUBSTRATE_PRIMITIVES); the CORE now always advertises the full platform-substrate primitive set, with the resource-sensitive primitives (memory_heap/high_memory/single_thread/cpu_time/thread_pool/multi_core/gpu) still gated on the live budget so a starved CORE fails step 5 honestly. A new coreCapabilities.test.ts asserts every requirement across DEFAULT_APOTHECARY_CATALOG is satisfied by a healthy CORE, that all resource-gated primitives are present at full budget, and that a starved CORE withholds them while keeping substrate services. (2) Dedicated picking proxies: selection in ThreeCanvas.tsx now raycasts a flat set of invisible coarse-sphere proxies (visible:false material, unrendered but raycastable) parented to each docked Orb, each satellite, and each vacant dock, instead of a recursive intersectObjects over the full detailed GLB subtree; each proxy carries its resolution target in userData.pick so the handler needs no tree walk, and natural depth ordering gives a satellite precedence over the orb behind it. Proxies are built in buildArm and refreshed by refreshPickProxies after every socket build/reconcile, and ride drag/spatial-override/turntable transforms because they are children of the node they represent. (3) Portal-motion intent RESOLVED by user decision: keep the in-place iris spin (commit 1ed453e); the C-0008 shortfall portal-static-invariant-drift-since-c0007 is closed and the standing-direction memory was updated from 'fully static' to 'iris spins in place'.
